observations: Phone logcat confirmed MATCH using manually selected tx nodes; UI selection captured separately.
Nginx gRPC requests returned 200 while actual Google/TLS requests timed out. Ingress acceptance is not end-to-end success.
Cloudflare XHTTP node was briefly selected as an independent control; this did not change EdgeOne origin or tx route.
No Nginx 413 or too-large lines were found during failed uploads.
Temporary per-host compression override and HTTP1 origin experiment did not solve the issue; original rule was restored.
Phone imported subscription restored byte-for-byte; SHA256 matched private on-device backup. Temporary 65536 setting not retained.
Windows diagnostic process has TUN and DNS interception disabled; existing Windows Clash was not changed.
Independent Windows results do not establish Android VPN acceptance. gRPC remains failing; goal must remain active.
Global EdgeOne gRPC switch verified restored OFF; tx rule origin remains dir.vpn.riko.asia.
Linux ARM64 helper TLS failures do not establish an Android app/core defect: helper lacks normal Android network integration. Helpers stopped.
Proxy-only upload succeeded once after handshake failure; full VPN retries failed. This does not establish stable connectivity or isolate a root cause.
Original automatic system traffic routing option restored ON; phone VPN stopped after tests.
Windows DNS returned tx.vpn.riko.asia as Clash Fake-IP 198.18.1.113. Earlier standalone Windows tests may have traversed existing Clash; not valid as proof of direct EdgeOne reachability.
Temporary pin of phone tx XHTTP server to live EdgeOne IP 43.174.246.63 kept SNI/Host tx.vpn.riko.asia and failed upload handshake at 5.050889 sec. Imported profile restored, SHA256 matches original.
Raw Android nc TLS experiments did not obtain a successful positive-control handshake; unsuitable to infer EdgeOne blocking. No verified network-blocking conclusion.
Native phone TLS1.2+h2 probe once received 1434 bytes at 5.77 seconds. Other SNI/ALPN probes did not respond. Does not establish TLS1.3-specific incompatibility or stable raw reachability.
Phone WS Google/upload again succeeded while XHTTP failed. Total inability to access Tencent from Wi-Fi is disproven; failed native probes cannot be generalized to all transports.
All Chrome fingerprint, tcp-concurrent, H1 diagnostic profile changes restored; SHA256 original. Phone VPN stopped, original Clash remains off.

Authenticated loopback controller used to verify actual selection and core version without screenshots. Temporary private override removed, app force-stopped and API ADB forward removed during cleanup.
Source ordinary tunnel dial timeout 5 seconds; controller 15 second URLTest could complete XHTTP Google204 request. A slower handshake/startup hypothesis is supported but not isolated as sole cause.

Server XHTTP requests verified HTTP/2 origin pull: 210 POST200 and46 GET200 in sampled eight-minute window. Tencent docs state default15sec timeout does not apply to H2 origin pull. No CDN timeout change made.
Original imported profile restored SHA256; no permanent core, server or CDN configuration change made in this turn. Goal incomplete.
next: Investigate XHTTP upload response truncation using transport-level errors; preserve five-second-vs-longer-probe evidence. Standard gRPC bidirectional stream remains outside EdgeOne documented L7 support.
